correctness.rationale: PASS: For odd SSH length 2M+1, TT† is M×M Jacobi Toeplitz with eigenvalues a²+b²+2ab cos(pi r/(M+1)) and sine eigenvectors. Every nonzero-energy eigenpair is dark precisely when (M+1)|rk for all losses k; Bézout gives r divisible by (M+1)/g, hence g-1 paired energies plus unique zero mode, dimension 2g-1. Dissipativity Re z=-<v,Gamma v>/(2||v||²) and reducing dark subspace ensure every orthogonal component decays; long-time total survival norm is the dark projection. Roots-of-unity identity gives even-site source projector exactly 0 if g divides ell, else g/(M+1). Independently diagonalized several H and checked ranks/projectors. Strict positive a,b,loss rates and nonempty even-site sets essential; does not guarantee individual occupation convergence.
